title: GTA6 Limited Edition Controller Revealed at September 2026 State of Play
description: Sony hosted a back-to-back State of Play showcase in September 2026, revealing major game updates and a surprise GTA6 limited edition controller.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Sony's September 2026 State of Play Delivers Double Features and GTA6 Hardware Teases

The gaming community has plenty to talk about following a unique double-feature broadcast format from Sony, as reported by gaming media outlet Push Square. In what marks a first for the platform holder, Sony ran two State of Play livestreams back-to-back: a standard showcase packed with general announcements, immediately followed by a State of Play Japan event highlighting developers from Japan and Asia. Together, these dual streams delivered a massive wave of game reveals and updates.

### Highlights from the Dual Showcases

The main State of Play livestream served up several major updates. Key moments included fresh content for *Gran Turismo 7*, a brand new look at *Saros*, and another deep dive into *Final Fantasy 7 Revelation*. Alongside these prominent titles, a variety of smaller announcements and updates caught the attention of players tuning in from around the globe.

### The GTA6 Limited Edition Controller Reveal

Among the assortment of smaller reveals during the broadcast, the surprise appearance of a GTA6 limited edition controller stood out as a major talking point for fans eagerly anticipating Rockstar Games' next blockbuster. While the showcase did not provide a specific release date, pricing, or technical details regarding the controller itself, the mere confirmation of official themed hardware has naturally intensified speculation and excitement surrounding the title's promotional rollout.

### Editor's Take

Sony's back-to-back approach proved to be an effective way to pack a massive amount of gaming news into a single event, successfully balancing global blockbusters with regional titles. While hardcore fans are still waiting for a deep dive into GTA6 gameplay, the debut of a branded controller suggests official merchandise partnerships are gearing up. It's a clever way to keep the hype train rolling.
